resources.string: The integrated terminal sets up a complete Linux environment inside the app\'s private storage: shell, JDK, package manager and command-line tools — to build and run your projects directly on the device.
About 40 MB to download, then packages install (the JDK alone takes more than 200 MB). A network connection is required.
Installation cancelled. You can restart it at any time.
Base environment installed (no additional tool requested).
Network unavailable. Check your connection, then retry.
Not enough storage space (about 1 GB free required). Free up space, then retry.
Invalid downloaded archive. Retry — if it persists, a new bootstrap version will be published.
The app\'s private storage refused an operation. Restart the app, then retry.
Package configuration failed. Retry — the installation restarts from scratch, harmlessly.
An embedded tool binary is missing from the app. A CodeIDE update will be required.
This device\'s architecture is not supported by the bootstrap yet (arm64 required).
